interval.description: The interval (window size) of the query.

metricNames.description: The names of the metrics (comma-separated) to retrieve.

aggregation.description: The list of aggregation types to retrieve.

filter.description: The $filter used to reduce the set of metric data returned.

top.description: The maximum number of records to retrieve.

orderBy.description: The aggregation to use for sorting results.

rollUpBy.description: Dimension name(s) to rollup results by.

resultType.description: Reduces the set of data collected.

metricNamespace.description: Metric namespace to query metric definitions for.

autoAdjustTimegrain.description: Auto-adjust the time grain based on the timespan.
